package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/generatedcourse"
)

type GeneratedCourseHandler struct {
	Ensure generatedcourse.Ensure
}

func (handler GeneratedCourseHandler) EnsureCourse(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	var payload domain.GeneratedCourse
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(writer, request.Body, domain.MaximumGeneratedCoursePayloadBytes))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&payload); err != nil || ensureJSONEOF(decoder) != nil {
		writeGeneratedCourseError(writer, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request")
		return
	}
	result, err := handler.Ensure.Handle(
		request.Context(), request.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"), payload,
	)
	if err != nil {
		switch {
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation):
			writeGeneratedCourseError(writer, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid_course_plan")
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict):
			writeGeneratedCourseError(writer, http.StatusConflict, "idempotency_conflict")
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
			writeGeneratedCourseError(writer, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "unsupported_course_reference")
		default:
			writeGeneratedCourseError(writer, http.StatusInternalServerError, "internal_error")
		}
		return
	}
	writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(writer).Encode(result)
}

func writeGeneratedCourseError(writer http.ResponseWriter, status int, code string) {
	writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	writer.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(writer).Encode(map[string]any{"error": map[string]string{"code": code}})
}
